newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Jan-Oct trade gap $3.489 bln, set to widen.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Jan-Oct trade gap $3.489 bln, set to widen.

text.p: Vietnam's Trade Ministry said on Saturday that the country recorded a trade deficit of $3.489 billion in the first 10 months of this year.
No comparative figures for the corresponding period of 1995 were given.
An official at the ministry, who declined to be named, said the full-year 1996 trade deficit was expected to be $4.0 billion compared with last year's $2.3 billion.
